content:
Kate started having a panic attack driving the camper. God I get so sick of having to pick up the pieces all the time. For shit that seems trivial too. I want to teach the kids independence exactly so they don't end up like this. 
Really I should have taken time off work and done all the driving and camper tasks myself... 
I think we need to have a proper talk about our roles. Then we can plan better. She can avoid the jobs that stress her out and I can hand over jobs she's capable of. We still don't do enough cleaning around the home. Idk how other couples manage without building resentment. Is it an us problem? Is it solvable? It doesn't feel like a blip, more like a beeping alarm that goes off frequently. I'm still super worried about the idea of losing this job because that'll only make everything harder. I'll have less money and less time. Maybe it's for the best for me, but it'll make her life harder, which in turn makes my life harder. Fuuuuck.
